answer: Dawn-Seeded Resource Titling: at first activity each identity claims a unique resource plot from a shared dune-like grid, and rewards accrue only to plots whose outputs other agents actually consume. A lotus symbol marks verified consumption links. Cloning requires claiming and sustaining separate plots with real downstream demand; unused plots decay and forfeit accrued rewards, so each fake identity costs ongoing compute and lost yield, exceeding one honest identity's cost.
